subject: Post a plot to a restful http endpoint

messages.author: 43604b83b60f48e6
messages.subject: Post a plot to a restful http endpoint
parts:
Hi, 

I'd like to take the output of a ggplot & post to a http endpoint for remote saving, eg. using httr. Would be ideal to do without an interim save step for speed as it may be many plots in 1 hit (actually, zipping would be a bonus). Any ideas?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Post a plot to a restful http endpoint
parts: I'd be surprised if saving the plot takes significant time compared to both the actual plotting and the uploading. At least worth measuring before you try to eliminate that step.
